about_company_text:
National Security Depository Limited (NSDL) is a SEBI registered market infrastructure institution. As of December 31, 2024, it is the largest depository in India, by number of issuers, active instruments, market share and value of assets.

The company provides depository services to support investors, brokers, issuers, and other market participants. The depository services enable customers to held their assets like listed and unlisted shares, warrants, funds like mutual funds, REITs, InvITs, and AIFs, and debt instruments like commercial paper, certificate of deposit, SGBs, etc. in dematerialized format in demat account.

As on Dec 31, 2024, it had 38.77 million active demat accounts with 289 depository participants. The company has a network of 63,542 depository participants service center.

about_company_text:
BLT Logistics Limited is a logistics and transportation company offering comprehensive surface transportation and warehousing solutions to a wide range of industries. The company leverages a combination of its own fleet, third-party operators, and its 99.99% subsidiary, Sabarmati Express India Private Limited, to provide reliable and flexible logistics services using containerized trucks. As of March 31, 2024, BLT Logistics operates a fleet of 90 vehicles (3.5 MT to 18 MT) and an additional 15 vehicles (9 MT) through its subsidiary.

BLT Logistics specializes in transportation and allied services such as Full Truck Load (FTL), Less than Truck Load (LTL), packing and moving, and project cargo transportation. These services are supported by advanced technology to ensure secure, efficient, and cost-effective logistics operations. The company caters to various business segments through a scalable transport network and a strong emphasis on operational precision.

about_company_text:
Essex Marine Limited, established in 2009, specializes in the procurement, processing, storage, and export of premium seafood products. Its diverse range includes ribbon fish, eel, various marine species, squid, mackerel, and Vannamei shrimp, which are shipped to markets in China, Belgium, and Japan.

The company’s cutting-edge processing plant in Midnapur, West Bengal, features IQF systems with Glazer and Hardener technology, plate freezers, blast freezers, and temperature-controlled storage, all operated under stringent HACCP, GMP, SSOP, FSSAI, and BRC standards.

Sourcing raw materials from India’s eastern seaboard, Essex Marine manages the end-to-end frozen fish and shrimp supply chain. Its prime facility at Shankarpur, near the Digha landing center in Purba Medinipur—renowned for Vannamei aquaculture—ensures proximity to fresh catch.

As of December 31, 2024, the company’s workforce comprised 91 skilled professionals across production, quality assurance, logistics, and support functions.
